6. Before going into that question it will be necessary here to state certain undisputed facts with relevant dates as staled by the parties. The nomination paper of the petitioner was rejected on 11.1.88 be the Returning Officer. On appeal under Rule 16(2) 0 Union Parishad (Election) Rules, 1983 the Addition- al Commissioner upheld the order of rejection or 14.1.88. Thereafter, Election Commission accepter the nomination paper of the petitioner on 15.1.88 Again the Election Commission revised its own order and found the petitioner to be disqualified to be elected as Chairman under Section 7(g) of the Local Government (Union Parishad) Ordinance, 1983 on 23.1.88. So it appears that the rejection of the nomination paper of the petitioner and its decision in that regard finally ended in the month of January, 1988. Thereafter the election was held on 10.2.88 Again in some centers fresh polls were held on 12.4.88. After the election was over the present suit was filed on 20.4.88. Result of the election was finally published in the Official Gazettee on 12.5.88 and Election Tribunal was constituted under Section 27 of the Ordinance on 19.3.88. The application for rejection of the plaint was filed on 2.5.88 and the impugned or- der was passed on 7.5.88. 

 9. Mr. M. Nurullah, the learned Attorney- General appearing for the opposite party Nos. 2-4, submits that the Election Tribunal having been constituted and the result having published earlier to filing of this suit, the petitioner could have filed an election petition before the Election Tribunal and he having not done so, the court has rightly rejected the plaint as parallel remedy cannot be availed of before the two courts at the same time. 

 11. In that reported decision a suit was filed soon after the nomination paper was finally rejected by the appellate authority and the reviewing authority under the Rules. The suit was filed by way of an injunction and the election was stopped.
